current_claim_or_gap: Related Work attributes the contribution to a combination of multi-factory application, induced vocabularies and inspectable text, but omits Vid2log.
prior_work_establishes: Vid2log already uses LLaVA, domain prompts, video-derived event data and temporal/semantic merging.
proposed_replacement: The contribution is the ordered construction of a shared factory representation before event assignment, with evidence about its analytical consequences.

current_claim_or_gap: First-person workflow extraction is acknowledged, but task tracking and retrospective analysis are not compared.
prior_work_establishes: First-person workflow tracking for assistance and unsupervised assembly workflow extraction predate this study.
repository_evidence: paper/sections/results.tex; video and worker case rules
proposed_replacement: Our objective is retrospective description of recorded workers, time composition and category transitions.

current_claim_or_gap: Abstract and pipeline use no task-specific training or manual input annotations.
prior_work_establishes: Kecht uses pretrained NLI with labeled threshold calibration; SnapLog adapts a classifier using labels.
repository_evidence: Four prompts; scripts 01 to 04; archived author audit; process-category map
proposed_replacement: No task-specific fine-tuning or labeled event examples are used for generation; prompts, categories and audit involve human input.
target: Abstract; Related Work; Pipeline; cover letter

prior_work_establishes: Preprint compares fine-tuning with prompting, supplies allowed activities, and evaluates against source logs.
repository_evidence: S3 vocabulary origin; S4 fixed-model extraction; transcript-based audit
proposed_replacement: Factory vocabulary induction and stage decomposition differ from learning the text-to-log transformation; no claim that fine-tuning is generally unnecessary.

current_claim_or_gap: Abstraction is discussed mainly as grouping and repeated-cycle compression.
prior_work_establishes: Abstraction changes the granularity at which a process is represented.
repository_evidence: S1 prompt; S2/S3 summaries and lists; S4 parser
proposed_replacement: Separate segmentation, activity-class construction and event-instance assignment; activity and process are two label dimensions.

current_claim_or_gap: Timestamped transcripts are described without their dense-captioning antecedent.
prior_work_establishes: Dense captioning localizes video events and describes them in language.
repository_evidence: S1 repetition rule; foundry transcript line 16 and CSV rows 17 and 18
proposed_replacement: Reusable names, episode granularity, source links and case rules turn descriptions into data for a stated analysis.

current_claim_or_gap: The dependency order is explicit but corpus adaptation is implicit.
prior_work_establishes: Prior approaches also use pretrained models and domain context; vocabulary constraints alone are not a novelty claim.
repository_evidence: S3 aggregates workers from each available factory; S4 reads its vocabularies
proposed_replacement: Parameters remain fixed while the factory corpus defines the vocabulary used to label that corpus; this is a retrospective assessment.

current_claim_or_gap: The resource is documented but has no comparison with an annotated video benchmark.
prior_work_establishes: Assembly101 provides multiview toy assembly recordings and action annotations for recognition, anticipation and segmentation.
repository_evidence: 322 transcripts/logs; 59 summaries; six reports; manifests and author audit
proposed_replacement: The linked release is an inferred process-analysis resource, not an independently annotated ground-truth benchmark.

current_claim_or_gap: S5 is described as merging without comparison with cross-source integration.
prior_work_establishes: Text2EL+ enriches an existing log; Sturm combines CRM, email metadata and call transcripts.
proposed_replacement: S1 to S4 construct events; S5 consolidates using supplied metadata and filename order. Generated representations share originating observations.

current_claim_or_gap: Case and synthetic-time limits are explicit but absent from the method comparison.
prior_work_establishes: Kecht retains recorded identifiers/timestamps; graph event data supports multiple entity relationships.
repository_evidence: Per-video offsets; S5 provenance columns; analytical video projection
proposed_replacement: Separate estimated boundaries, source identifiers, chosen cases and synthetic time; storage cannot create product identities.

current_claim_or_gap: The error-source table lists checks and consequences, but few rows name an existing example.
prior_work_establishes: Quality-aware construction and recurring log imperfections are established concerns.
repository_evidence: Audit partial-support cases; timestamp anomalies; foundry split; transport map; merge code
proposed_replacement: Explain how successive transformations preserve or lose information and distinguish observed issues from possible mechanisms.

current_claim_or_gap: The draft already rejects calibrated uncertainty and a total downstream bound; the quality-annotation comparison is absent.
prior_work_establishes: Quality annotations retain known defects; explicitly uncertain events support bounded conformance; SnapLog can retain candidate-label distributions.
repository_evidence: Single-valued CSV fields; five-second evaluation rule; audit
proposed_replacement: The tolerance is a matching rule, not an event uncertainty interval; quality metadata and explicit alternatives would require added evidence.

current_claim_or_gap: Metrics and limits are defined, but references and evaluation objects are not compared across studies.
prior_work_establishes: Source traces and independent video annotations provide different reference structures.
repository_evidence: Archived audit, boundary metric, discovery outputs, category map
proposed_replacement: Separate visual accuracy, textual consistency, boundary accuracy, computation feasibility and validity of operational conclusions.
